summary: Bug fix verification complete: Stage reordering in Leads module now works correctly. The root cause was a FastAPI route ordering conflict where /stages/reorder was placed after /stages/{stage_id}, causing 'reorder' to be interpreted as a stage_id. Fix confirmed: static route now placed before dynamic route.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Route ordering fix properly implemented - /stages/reorder now before /stages/{stage_id} at line 155
GOOD: data-testid attributes added for move buttons: move-stage-up-{index}, move-stage-down-{index}
GOOD: Login correctly redirects to /leads instead of /dashboard
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stage reordering bug fixed and verified. The /api/leads-v2/stages/reorder endpoint works correctly. Move up/down buttons in Stages modal functional with proper data-testid attributes. Kanban board reflects stage order changes. 5 existing stages: Contacted, Proposal, RNR, Follow-up, Converted.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: FastAPI route ordering conflict - static routes must be defined BEFORE dynamic routes
rca_of_the_issue.problem: /stages/reorder was defined AFTER /stages/{stage_id}, causing 'reorder' to be captured as stage_id parameter
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Moved @leads_v2_router.put('/stages/reorder') to line 155, before @leads_v2_router.put('/stages/{stage_id}') at line 172
rca_of_the_issue.verification: API now correctly routes to reorder handler, returns 200 with 'Stages reordered' message, and persists order changes to database
